etsy.title: Christmas Elf Bundle Printable, Elf Letters, Easy Elf Ideas, Kindness Advent Calendar, Elf Arrival Letter, Kindness Elf Kit, 36 Pages
etsy.description:
Three of our most-loved Christmas printables in one bundle, for a calm, kind and magical December. 🎄

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (36 pages)
1) Elf Lifesaver Letters – 30 ready-to-print letters from your elf for the tricky moments: arrival, late arrival, "I got touched", "are you real?", goodbye and more
2) Easy Christmas Elf Ideas – 30 no-mess, 5-minute setups with things you already have, a 24-day planner and elf-size signs
3) Kindness Advent Calendar – 24 kindness missions, a color-in tracker, dinner talk cards and a Kindness Champion certificate

Bought separately these three kits cost 11.97 EUR in our shop; the bundle is 7.99 EUR.

👧👦 For families with kids ages 3 to 12, and classrooms.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included. Print at home on paper or card stock.

PLEASE NOTE
"Christmas Elf" is a generic name for this activity. Not affiliated with any elf doll brand: use any toy you already have. For personal and single-classroom use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
